t2.thesis: NOW has run up about 18% in a month into the print and has fallen after each of its last four prints, so the setup is slightly unfavorable even though the implied move of about 10% leaves the outcome close to a coin flip.
reasons: Last four prints were all negative at the next open (win rate 0/4), including -14% in April and -10% in January, so the stock reacts harshly to prints.
The stock is up 18% over 1 month and 8.8% over 7 days into the print, which raises the bar for a beat to be rewarded.
The implied move of about 10% is large, so the outcome is driven by a big binary reaction rather than drift.
Estimate revisions are flat and the last beat was solid (5% EPS surprise, subscription revenue above the high end of guidance), which supports a decent print and keeps the odds near even.
The software sector has recovered recently, which gives some tailwind, but the run-up already prices much of it.
t2.deciding_variable: Whether cRPO and subscription growth (about 21% cRPO) and the Q4 guidance, along with Armis security integration and margin commentary, clear a bar lifted by the recent rally.

prior.from: I3 overall validation hit rate 54.2%; AMC 53.8%; software_internet cluster 54.1%
